name: attraction-lead-magnet
description: PLUGIN 3 — Lead Magnets & Opt-In Funnels pointed at agents (Week 2). Offer-first, one sitting: it builds your Partner Offer in the same session if it isn't built yet, recommends ONE lead magnet built from your unique value proposition and Mike's lessons (say yes, or ask for the next best), writes the magnet and its sales funnel outline (the opt-in page, the thank-you page with the download and the call), and puts the guide and the page into your Week 3 Kit — the one file (your offer too) you upload to Claude Design in Week 3. Then: delivery by DM, email and story (the ManyChat GUIDE keyword), the nurture sequence and weekly newsletter, partnership outreach, your Google Business Profile positioned for attraction, bios aligned to the funnel (the Short-Form System refreshes them in Week 3), and analytics on opt-in rate, list growth and magnet-to-call conversion. No default magnet; no two members' magnets alike. Reads the Agent Attraction Brain; requires Plugin 1.
